tearsheet.meta.title: troid's research — tearsheet
tearsheet.head.box: A full tearsheet on a strategy whose holdout expectancy is +0.008R. Every metric below is MEASURED and inside noise. Published because that is what noise looks like when someone shows you all of it.
tearsheet.head.sample: {n} closed trades on {market}, {start} to {end}. Daily P&L on the {quota} quota, days without an exit count as zero, 365 periods a year, sums not products. Source: journal.csv in the repo. Not financial advice.
tearsheet.stub.english: The report itself — every metric, table and chart — is generated in English by quantstats and is published once, untranslated: the full tearsheet.
